description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

You command the attention of those who can hear you with a truly haunting song. Attempt a Performance check and compare it to the Will DC of each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15]. Regardless of the result, each creature then becomes immune to your Hypnotic Melody for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fatigued] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fascinated] with you for 1 round as your song seems to lull them to sleep.

Success The target is fatigued for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.
